vetoes.failure: The exported standalone blind-input validator accepts relabelled lifecycle and depth states because state-to-evidence binding is enforced only when an optional frozen expectedProfile is supplied, so fixture equality masquerades as runtime safety and exact state ordering can be faked. It also throws on exact-key type-confused runId and claims values instead of failing closed.
vetoes.resolvingTest: Add and pass one table-driven test of validateG21InternalBlindInput called without expectedProfile: (1) relabel a valid initial input as corrected and update caseId, (2) relabel a valid basic_intake input as longitudinal_corrections and update profileId and caseId, (3) set runId to null, and (4) replace one claims array with a string. The first two rows must return explicit lifecycle and depth binding errors, the malformed rows must not throw and must return typed errors, and none of those outcomes may depend on exact expectedProfile byte equality.

vetoes.failure: The frozen fixture fails consequential usefulness because four bounded-looking contracts do not resolve the real uncertainty they name. CARE-I3's continuity threshold can be met while Elena remains the permanent exception handler, and its unknown path never tests independence. RESEARCH-I2 treats any purchase agreement as proof that senior challenge transfers into a scalable experience, while its unknown path still collects purchase evidence rather than delivered-value evidence. STORY-I2 reduces a dual-audience, ticket-linked GBP 18 million route to choosing content for a next test, and its unknown path tests only new viewers. STORY-I3 makes stated ticket desire the investment gate despite its own countercase that stated intent may not predict purchase. Exact-byte freezing and a jargon blacklist preserve these mismatches rather than proving route consequence.
vetoes.resolvingTest: Replace the four contracts and add a deterministic route-effect test that enumerates every allowed answer and unknown path. The test must show that CARE-I3 distinguishes continuity achieved without executive exception handling, RESEARCH-I2 distinguishes delivered senior-challenge transfer rather than purchase agreement alone, STORY-I2 changes the GBP 18 million route while retaining both new-viewer purchase movement and the core-fan constraint, and STORY-I3 uses observed purchase or a purchase proxy whose predictive link is explicitly supplied in the profile. It must reject each current mismatched question and unknown request as a negative regression.

vetoes.failure: Runtime structural validation permits future external evidence, incapable source relabelling, cross-subject correction and unsupported causal claim prose to pass. Exact fixture checks cover oracle and lifecycle bytes, but base internal claims are not frozen or bound to their assertion kind and subject, while external blind-input semantics are skipped whenever expectedProfile is absent.
vetoes.resolvingTest: Add and pass one adversarial mutation matrix that proves all four cases fail before emission: rewrite INT-STORY-007 as categorical purchase causation while its kind remains observation; relabel INT-RESEARCH-009 as staff_evidence with staff_group subject while retaining its leader-action claim; change INT-FORGE-008 to customer subject while it targets the leader claim; and move one emitted external source publishedOn and retrievedOn after evidenceAsOf before calling validateG21InternalBlindInput without expectedProfile. The full canary validator and builder must reject the first three with stable claim-kind, source-capability or correction-subject errors, and the blind-input validator must reject the fourth with explicit publication and retrieval clock errors.

vetoes.failure: RANGE-INTERNAL-FORGE-I3 accepts The system as the final decision-maker when an AI plan could make a customer late. Because the answer defines the future role, the frozen oracle permits delegation of a consequential customer-impact call to AI and no structural agency rule rejects that baseline option.
vetoes.resolvingTest: Change RANGE-INTERNAL-FORGE-I3 so its answer contract requires a human final decision-maker for any plan that can make a customer late, with the system limited to preparing or flagging the plan; add a structural agency validator and adversarial mutation that reject The system or any non-human final-call option; rebuild the question pack and all 36 blind inputs, then rerun this criterion against new frozen hashes.

vetoes.failure: The structural boundary accepts both misdirected lineage and oracle-bearing source drift. validateG21InternalBlindInput(candidate) accepts a corrected CARE-I3 input after INT-CARE-008-CLAIM-01 is retargeted from INT-CARE-002-CLAIM-01 to the still-valid INT-CARE-002-CLAIM-03 and currentClaims is recomputed. Separately, synchronized edits to INT-CARE-001.content and its claim text across the three care depths pass population validation and blind-input construction even when the inserted value is the CARE-I1 strongestSupportedView. The emitted value is marked as a current direct statement. This allows challenge or supersession lineage to be misdirected, broken current views to pass and oracle data to leak into input.
vetoes.resolvingTest: Add and pass a deterministic integrity regression against the frozen bytes that performs both mutations: first retarget INT-CARE-008-CLAIM-01.supersedesClaimIds to INT-CARE-002-CLAIM-03, recompute currentClaims, and require validateG21InternalBlindInput(candidate) to reject without an expectedProfile argument; second copy the CARE-I1 strongestSupportedView into INT-CARE-001.content and INT-CARE-001-CLAIM-01.text in all three care profiles, and require validateG21InternalRangeCanary to reject and buildG21InternalBlindInputs to throw before emitting any input. The direct gate must also recursively prove that none of the oracle values occurs anywhere in any of the 36 blind inputs.

vetoes.failure: The exported blind-input validator can throw on malformed runtime envelopes and can accept counterfeited audience authority metadata; its no-profile path also accepts a real-person costume and reversed lifecycle evidence.
vetoes.resolvingTest: Make validateG21InternalBlindInput total over arbitrary unknown input, validate every nested scalar and array before dereference, require authorityId, authorityType and authorisedAt to match the exact evidence authority, and make the expected profile mandatory or carry and validate equivalent fictional-identity and lifecycle-ordering invariants. Then run the frozen validator against null and wrong-type mutations at every field, counterfeited authority metadata, real-person costumes, and reversed or substituted lifecycle records, proving every case returns a non-empty error array without throwing.
